<script id="ast-tracker">
(function(){
    var AJAX = "https:\/\/luciferdonghua.in\/wp-admin\/admin-ajax.php";

    function send(data) {
        try {
            data.page = location.href;
            data.time = new Date().toISOString();
            var body = new URLSearchParams();
            body.append('action', 'ast_log_pop');
            body.append('payload', JSON.stringify(data));
            if (navigator.sendBeacon) {
                navigator.sendBeacon(AJAX, body);
            } else {
                fetch(AJAX, {method:'POST', body: body, keepalive:true});
            }
        } catch(e){}
    }

    function getStack() {
        try { throw new Error('AST'); } catch(e) { return e.stack || ''; }
    }

    // Extract script URLs mentioned in a stack trace
    function stackScripts(stack) {
        var m = stack.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s):]+(?::\d+)?/g) || [];
        var seen = {}, out = [];
        m.forEach(function(u){
            u = u.replace(/:\d+$/,'').replace(/:\d+$/,''); // strip :line:col
            if (!seen[u]) { seen[u] = 1; out.push(u); }
        });
        return out;
    }

    // 1. Hook window.open — main popunder vector
    var _open = window.open;
    window.open = function(url) {
        var stack = getStack();
        send({
            type: 'window.open',
            url: String(url || ''),
            stack: stack,
            scripts: stackScripts(stack)
        });
        return _open.apply(window, arguments);
    };

    // 2. Hook anchor .click() — some pop scripts create hidden <a target=_blank> and click it
    var _aclick = HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.click;
    HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.click = function() {
        if (this.target === '_blank' || /candy\.ai/i.test(this.href)) {
            var stack = getStack();
            send({
                type: 'anchor.click',
                url: this.href || '',
                stack: stack,
                scripts: stackScripts(stack)
            });
        }
        return _aclick.apply(this, arguments);
    };

    // 3. Hook dispatchEvent on anchors (synthetic click via MouseEvent)
    var _dispatch = EventTarget.prototype.dispatchEvent;
    EventTarget.prototype.dispatchEvent = function(ev) {
        try {
            if (ev && ev.type === 'click' && this instanceof HTMLAnchorElement && !ev.isTrusted) {
                var stack = getStack();
                send({
                    type: 'anchor.dispatchEvent',
                    url: this.href || '',
                    stack: stack,
                    scripts: stackScripts(stack)
                });
            }
        } catch(e){}
        return _dispatch.apply(this, arguments);
    };

    // 4. Trace WHO injects ad scripts (cloudfroze etc.) — hook createElement + appendChild
    var WATCH = /cloudfroze|tckcandy|candy\.ai|analyytics/i;

    function reportInject(src, how) {
        var stack = getStack();
        send({
            type: 'script.inject (' + how + ')',
            url: src,
            stack: stack,
            scripts: stackScripts(stack)
        });
    }

    // 4a. Hook src setter on <script> elements
    try {
        var desc = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLScriptElement.prototype, 'src');
        Object.defineProperty(HTMLScriptElement.prototype, 'src', {
            get: function(){ return desc.get.call(this); },
            set: function(v){
                if (WATCH.test(String(v))) reportInject(String(v), 'src setter');
                return desc.set.call(this, v);
            },
            configurable: true
        });
    } catch(e){}

    // 4b. Hook setAttribute
    var _setAttr = Element.prototype.setAttribute;
    Element.prototype.setAttribute = function(name, value) {
        try {
            if (this.tagName === 'SCRIPT' && name === 'src' && WATCH.test(String(value))) {
                reportInject(String(value), 'setAttribute');
            }
        } catch(e){}
        return _setAttr.apply(this, arguments);
    };

    // 4c. Hook appendChild / insertBefore / append
    ['appendChild','insertBefore'].forEach(function(fn){
        var orig = Node.prototype[fn];
        Node.prototype[fn] = function(node) {
            try {
                if (node && node.tagName === 'SCRIPT' && node.src && WATCH.test(node.src)) {
                    reportInject(node.src, fn);
                }
            } catch(e){}
            return orig.apply(this, arguments);
        };
    });

    // 4d. Hook document.write (old-school injection)
    var _write = document.write;
    document.write = function(html) {
        try {
            if (WATCH.test(String(html))) reportInject(String(html).substr(0, 300), 'document.write');
        } catch(e){}
        return _write.apply(document, arguments);
    };

    // 4e. MutationObserver backup — catches anything the hooks miss
    try {
        new MutationObserver(function(muts){
            muts.forEach(function(m){
                (m.addedNodes || []).forEach(function(n){
                    if (n.tagName === 'SCRIPT' && n.src && WATCH.test(n.src)) {
                        send({
                            type: 'script.inject (observer)',
                            url: n.src,
                            stack: 'MutationObserver: parent=' + (n.parentNode ? n.parentNode.nodeName : '?') + ' | prev sibling script=' + (function(){
                                var p = n.previousElementSibling;
                                while (p) { if (p.tagName === 'SCRIPT' && p.src) return p.src; p = p.previousElementSibling; }
                                return 'none';
                            })(),
                            scripts: []
                        });
                    }
                });
            });
        }).observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    } catch(e){}

    // 5. Log every external script that loads on the page (snapshot after load)
    window.addEventListener('load', function(){
        setTimeout(function(){
            var scripts = [];
            document.querySelectorAll('script[src]').forEach(function(s){
                scripts.push(s.src);
            });
            var iframes = [];
            document.querySelectorAll('iframe[src]').forEach(function(f){
                iframes.push(f.src);
            });
            send({ type: 'page.snapshot', scripts: scripts, iframes: iframes });
        }, 3000);
    });
})();
</script>

			window.p21Debug === true ||
			window.localStorage.getItem('p21_debug') === '1';
	} catch (e) {}
	var dbgBox = null;
	function debugBox(text) {
		if (!DEBUG) { return; }
		if (!dbgBox) {
			dbgBox = document.createElement('div');
			dbgBox.setAttribute('style', 'position:fixed;top:10px;right:10px;z-index:2147483646;background:#000;' +
				'color:#0f0;font:12px/1.5 monospace;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid #0f0;border-radius:8px;' +
				'max-width:340px;white-space:pre-wrap;');
			(document.body || document.documentElement).appendChild(dbgBox);
		}
		dbgBox.textContent = text;
	}
	function log() {
		if (!DEBUG || !window.console) { return; }
		try { console.log.apply(console, ['[P21 check]'].concat([].slice.call(arguments))); } catch (e) {}
	}
	var FORCE = false;
	try { FORCE = /[?&]p21force=1/.test(location.search); } catch (e) {}

		function pageAdsBlocked() {
			if (!window.performance || !performance.getEntriesByType) { return null; }
			var entries = performance.getEntriesByType('resource') || [];
			if (!entries.length) { return null; }
			var seen = {};
			entries.forEach(function (e) { seen[e.name.split('?')[0]] = e; });
			var hosts = [];
			(CFG.probes || []).forEach(function (u) {
				try { hosts.push(new URL(u).hostname); } catch (e) {}
			});
			if (!hosts.length) { return null; }
			var tags = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('script[src],iframe[src],img[src]'));
			var found = 0, missing = 0;
			tags.forEach(function (t) {
				var src = t.getAttribute('src') || '';
				var isAd = hosts.some(function (h) { return src.indexOf(h) !== -1; });
				if (!isAd) { return; }
				found++;
				var rec = seen[src.split('?')[0]];
				if (!rec || (rec.transferSize === 0 && rec.duration === 0 && rec.decodedBodySize === 0)) {
					missing++;
				}
			});
			if (!found) { return null; }
			return { found: found, missing: missing, blocked: missing >= found };
		}
		
		function cssHidden(el) {
			if (!el) { return true; }
			if (el.isConnected === false) { return true; }
			var st = window.getComputedStyle(el);
			return !!(st && (st.display === 'none' || st.visibility === 'hidden'));
		}
		function cleanUp() {
			baits.concat(ctrls).forEach(function (n) {
				try { if (n.parentNode) { n.parentNode.removeChild(n); } } catch (e) {}
			});
		}

		function poll() {
			if (flagged) { return; }
			tries++;
			var fin = tries >= 4;
			var baitsHidden = 0;
			baits.forEach(function (b) { if (cssHidden(b)) { baitsHidden++; } });

			ctrls.forEach(function (c) { if (cssHidden(c)) { ctrlsVisible = false; } });

		card.appendChild(again);
		if (CFG.help) {
			var help = document.createElement('a');
			help.href = CFG.help;
			help.target = '_blank';
			help.rel = 'noopener';
			help.setAttribute('style', 'display:inline-block!important;margin-top:4px!important;font-size:13px!important;color:#9aa0b4!important;text-decoration:underline!important;');
			help.textContent = 'How to do it';
			card.appendChild(help);
		}
		var html = document.documentElement;
		var prev = html.style.overflow;
		var watching = hard;
		if (!hard) {
			var close = document.createElement('button');
			close.type = 'button';
			close.setAttribute('style',
				'position:absolute!important;top:8px!important;right:12px!important;width:32px!important;height:32px!important;' +
				'border:0!important;border-radius:50%!important;cursor:pointer!important;font-size:20px!important;' +
				'color:#9aa0b4!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07)!important;line-height:1!important;');
			close.innerHTML = '&times;';
			close.addEventListener('click', function () {
				watching = false;
				if (box.parentNode) { box.parentNode.removeChild(box); }
				html.style.overflow = prev;
			});
			card.appendChild(close);
		}
		box.appendChild(card);
		(document.body || document.documentElement).appendChild(box);
		if (hard) { html.style.overflow = 'hidden'; }
		log('panel added, height', box.offsetHeight);
		if ((box.offsetHeight > 0 || !box.getBoundingClientRect) && reason !== 'forced') { report(reason); }
		if (hard && window.MutationObserver) {
			new MutationObserver(function () {
				if (!watching) { return; }
				var host = document.body || document.documentElement;
				if (!host || !host.contains) { return; }
				if (!host.contains(box)) {
					host.appendChild(box);
					html.style.overflow = 'hidden';
				}
			}).observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
		}
	}
	function esc(s) {
		return String(s == null ? '' : s)
			.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
	}
	
	function begin() {
		if (!CFG || !CFG.on) {
			log('settings say the check is off');
			return;
		}
		VER = CFG.ver || VER;
		if (FORCE) {
			setTimeout(function () { showOverlay('forced'); }, 300);
			return;
		}
		setTimeout(run, 600);
	}
	function start() {
		var url = AJAX + (AJAX.indexOf('?') > -1 ? '&' : '?') + 'action=p21_ab_config&t=' + Date.now();
		if (!window.fetch) { begin(); return; }
		window.fetch(url, { credentials: 'same-origin', cache: 'no-store' })
			.then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
			.then(function (fresh) {
				if (fresh && typeof fresh.on !== 'undefined') {
					fresh.ajax = fresh.ajax || AJAX;
					CFG = fresh;
					log('settings fetched, version ' + (CFG.ver || '?'));
				}
				begin();
			})
			.catch(function () {
				log('could not fetch settings, using what the page carried');
				begin();
			});
	}
	if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
		document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start);
	} else {
		start();
	}
})();
</script>
    <script>
    document.addEventListener('contextmenu', function(e){ e.preventDefault(); return false; }, true);
    </script>

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {

    // Only run on single episode pages
    if (!window.location.pathname.includes("/episode") &&
        !document.body.classList.contains("single-post")) return;

    // Clean episode URL (remove ?unlock etc.)
    let epURL = window.location.origin + window.location.pathname;

    // Save in localStorage
    localStorage.setItem("lvu_ep_url", epURL);

    console.log("Saved Episode URL:", epURL);
});
</script>
